author: Today I Found Out
description:
In today's compilation video, we are looking at what happened to the Creators of The Far Side, Calvin and Hobbes, Garfield, and Peanuts, and one of the most bizarre coincidences in entertainment history that gave the world two of its most iconic comics.

0:00 What Happened to the Creator of The Far Side?
8:09 What Happened to the Creator of Calvin and Hobbes?
17:13 What Happened to the Creator of Garfield?
31:34 What Happened to the Creator of Peanuts?
49:32 The Most Bizarre Coincidence in Entertainment History That Birthed Two of the World's Most Iconic Comics
title: What Happened to the Creators of The Far Side, Calvin and Hobbes, Garfield, and Peanuts?
